intent: A deeply believable private marriage proposal between Dominic and Marion. Emotional realism over spectacle; it must feel witnessed, not staged.
location: quiet Mediterranean terrace at golden hour, intimate and private, warm stone, subtle vegetation, distant soft horizon

continuityState.lighting: warm low natural sunlight becoming softer; no artificial glamour lighting

wardrobe.Lucas: elegant but natural dark shirt, sleeves relaxed, canonical tattoos preserved where visible
wardrobe.Marion: simple elegant light summer outfit, natural styling

appearance.Lucas: canonical Dominic identity, exact face/hair/stubble/body proportions/tattoos
appearance.Marion: canonical Marion identity, natural face, dark blond/light brown mid-length wavy hair, light eyes, cheek mole preserved

beats.intent: They arrive together with Marion unaware of what is about to happen.
beats.action: They walk slowly onto the terrace. Dominic is slightly quieter than usual without acting suspicious. Marion looks outward, then back at him. Natural walking, breathing and tiny clothing movement.
beats.emotion: calm, familiar, slight hidden tension from Dominic

beats.intent: Dominic tries to begin, stops for a fraction, then commits.
beats.action: Dominic turns toward Marion, briefly looks down, exhales through a small nervous smile and takes her hand. Marion notices the change in him and studies his face.

beats.intent: He speaks simply rather than delivering a rehearsed speech.
beats.action: Dominic keeps her hand, holds eye contact, breaks it once naturally, then looks back at her.

beats.intent: The realization reaches Marion before the ring is fully presented.
beats.action: Dominic releases one hand and goes down on one knee naturally. He takes a small ring box from his pocket and opens it. Marion freezes for a beat, breath catches, one hand rises toward her mouth; no exaggerated crying.
beats.emotion: Dominic focused and emotional; Marion stunned, overwhelmed

beats.intent: Let the question land without music-video theatrics.
beats.action: Close but not intrusive camera. Dominic looks directly at Marion and asks. Hold on Marion afterward instead of cutting immediately.

beats.intent: Marion reacts before she can form the answer.
beats.action: Marion gives a tiny disbelieving laugh through emotion, looks away for half a second, back to Dominic, nods before words come. Eyes wet but restrained. Dominic waits; he does not interrupt.

Marion answers yes. Dominic's expression changes immediately, relieved and emotional. He stands, gently puts the ring on her finger; their hands are clearly anatomically correct and the ring remains consistent.

beats.intent: End on them, not on the ring.
beats.action: Marion moves into Dominic before he can say much more. They embrace tightly, then separate just enough to look at each other and share a spontaneous small laugh. Dominic touches his forehead briefly to hers. Camera stays human and close, then eases back slightly.

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.text: J'avais préparé plein de trucs à te dire… et là, j'ai tout oublié.
dialogue.intent: admit his nerves instead of performing
dialogue.delivery: low, warm, slightly breathy, tiny nervous smile, one natural hesitation
dialogue.listenerBehavior: watches him closely, smile fades into attentive emotion

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.text: Je sais juste que je veux continuer tout ça avec toi.
dialogue.delivery: quiet and direct, no speech cadence

dialogue.speaker: Lucas
dialogue.delivery: very simple, intimate, slightly vulnerable; breathe before Marion's name
dialogue.listenerBehavior: silent stunned reaction first; answer must not be immediate

dialogue.speaker: Marion
dialogue.delivery: first yes almost breathed, second clearer with a small emotional laugh
dialogue.listenerBehavior: instant visible relief, soft laugh, eyes remain on her

engagementRing.description: elegant understated engagement ring, realistic scale, same ring and box in every shot

rules: favor medium close shots and reaction holds over coverage
do not orbit around kneeling Dominic
do not use artificial rack-focus gimmicks
never cut away from Marion at the first instant of realization
camera operator feels physically present but unobtrusive

soundDirection.ambience: real terrace air, distant soft environment only, no intelligible background voices
soundDirection.performance: breaths and micro-pauses remain audible; no announcer delivery
